payload.blocks: Phase 5 cannot land the migrate verb, so the data move (unit 2) and phases 6-7 wait. Unit 1's code (migrate.rs, its test, readers) is written and saved; nothing else in the plan can move meanwhile.
payload.headline: Phase 5: add 5 wiring files to the plan footprint so `fgos migrate portfolio` is reachable?

parts.cause: Answer q-ekkgwaavrb named the CLI wiring for the verb but the planner listed mod.rs/routing.rs/cli_projector.rs; the host also routes through main.rs and two route contracts. The Cargo.toml need comes from step 3 (convention paths, not strings).

options.cost: One footprint edit commit; about one more unit run.
options.does: Supervisor/planner adds the 5 paths to the footprint; unit 1 finishes the verb and convention-read roots, then unit 2 moves the data.
options.gain: Phase 5 delivers exactly as written: reachable verb, no hard-coded roots.
options.harm: Two crate manifests gain one internal dependency each.
options.label: Add all 5 paths

options.does: Register the verb; readers keep the discussion/backlog roots as constants in their own crate.
options.harm: Step 3 (convention paths) stays half done; the roots live in two places.
options.label: Add only the 3 route files

options.does: Run the migration once in this repo via the test fixture code path; external projects get the verb in a later item.
options.harm: Mission #1 projects get no upgrade path now; step 4 undone.
options.label: Drop the verb from phase 5

parts.recommendation: Add all 5 paths: it is what step 3 and step 4 of the phase already require, and the change to each file is one route row or one dependency line.

scope.allows: Adding exactly these 5 paths to the plan footprint for phase 5.
scope.forbids: Any other footprint change or any change to land behaviour.

parts.what: Unit 1 of phase 5 wrote the single Rust implementation of `fgos migrate portfolio` (apps/fgos/src/wiring/migrate.rs, tests/migrate_portfolio.rs) and the path readers, but the verb is unreachable until it is routed in apps/fgos/src/main.rs, packages/host-runtime/contracts/command-routes.json and command-route-annotations.json. Reading roots from convention rules (step 3) needs an fgos-convention dependency in packages/questions/rust/Cargo.toml and packages/supervision/rust/Cargo.toml. None of these 5 paths is in the footprint.
